flags.why: Biết tay means to experience someone's prowess; the meaning 'to show people what one is capable of' requires cho người ta biết tay.
flags.fix: to experience what someone is capable of

flags.why: Biển lận means stingy or miserly, rather than greedy ([dictionary](https://tudien.dolenglish.vn/bien-lan-tieng-anh-la-gi)).
The example describes a miserly man, rather than a greedy man ([dictionary](https://tudien.dolenglish.vn/bien-lan-tieng-anh-la-gi)).
flags.fix: He is known as a miserly man.

flags.why: Biện bác is formal vocabulary and needs a warning against using it as an ordinary conversational equivalent of 'argue against'.
Biện giải is formal vocabulary rather than an everyday conversational word for explaining or justifying something.
Biện luận denotes formal argumentation and is misleading as an unmarked conversational equivalent of 'argue'.
Biệt đãi is formal vocabulary for giving preferential treatment.
The noun use of biệt đãi is also formal vocabulary.
